note: _eam cum se duxerit_ (Weber/Gryson, Scarpat) – when it goes away. For _se ducere_ = _abire_, see Philipp Thielmann: _Beiträge zur Textkritik der Vulgata, insbes. des Buches Judith. Beigabe zum Jahresbericht 1882/83 der Königlichen Studienanstalt Speier_. Speyer 1883 (64 pp.), pp. 16–17; Scarpat I, p. 446.
_fascinatio enim nugacionis obscurat bona_– the evil eye of wikedness obscures what is good. – John H. Elliott: _Beware the Evil Eye_. Volume 3. Eugene, Ore. 2016 (xxx, 348 pp.), pp. 13 and 56.
